programs.title: How It's Made 20
programs.sub_title: Hairdresser's scissors, wheels for horse-drawn carriages, cookies for toasters, bows
programs.desc: Every day, modern people are surrounded by objects that they are so used to that they don't seem to notice.The creators of the series reveal the behind-the-scenes of the production of such things as cowboy boots, buses, ballet shoes, sinks and trumpets.They visit factories in various places around the world and follow the often very complicated production process - from obtaining raw materials to the final product.The episodes of the new series will explain, among others:how tissues, orange liqueur, belt buckles and croissants are made.
